open_questions: Community Association Managers: statute part not displayed on the opened DBPR page — cited at chapter level (Fla. Stat. Ch. 468); verify Part VIII during the extraction round.

Candidate boards for a future round (license codes verified on the official DBPR occupation-code table, but no dedicated board page opened this round): Asbestos Consultants / Asbestos Contractors (Ch. 469), Professional Geologists (Ch. 492), Athlete Agents (Ch. 468, Pt. IX).
Real estate appraisers (Ch. 475, Pt. II) and real estate brokerage (Ch. 475, Pt. I) excluded — they sit under DBPR's Division of Real Estate and likely belong to a different research area.
Inactive/delinquent and endorsement license variants exist for most boards (e.g., CPA endorsement, temporary permits) but were not enumerated here — enumerate in the extraction round.
